headline: Colombia becomes first Latin American country to ban FGM
summary: Congress passed the ban unanimously, capping a long campaign by Emberá women activists against the practice.
script: Colombia has become the first country in Latin America to ban female genital mutilation. Congress passed the law unanimously, after years of campaigning by activists from the Emberá community, where the practice still occurs.
imageAlt: Activist Carla Quiñonez, an Emberá woman working to end female genital cutting in her community.
imageAltTwo: Three generations of Emberá women in traditional dress, representing the community at the heart of the campaign.
